_comment: Speeds and attack_range are final world units, already multiplied by IsoVolume.WORLD_SCALE (1.2708197158225134). Do not scale them again. attack_speed is attacks per second. hp, defense, and attack are points. Villagers fill house beds. Spearmen, gunners, and engineers fill the matching barracks or workshop vacancies on wave clear. They are not converted from villagers. Contact still infects a villager in one touch. Fighters spend their attack stats and die on hit points.

units.notes: Cosmetic pool for the auto villagers. move_speed is the old 108 * WORLD_SCALE. Wander still uses 0.72x of it and panic 1.15x, in villager.gd.
Knight sheet (villager_3). move_speed and attack_range are 90 and 48 times WORLD_SCALE. Settles into spear barracks vacancies.
Robot sheet (villager_5). Settles into workshop vacancies. move_speed and attack_range are 100 and 42 times WORLD_SCALE.
Raccoon sheet (villager_2). move_speed and attack_range are 105 and 220 times WORLD_SCALE. Settles into gun barracks vacancies.
